facts: NuScale ended Q2 2026 with $1.9 billion in cash, cash equivalents and short/long-term investments.
Q2 revenue decreased by $8.0 million year over year, primarily because RoPower FEED Phase 2 services completed in late 2025 had no comparable 2026 activity.
R&D expense increased $6.6 million year over year, primarily from higher NPM component readiness/design-maturity activity.
NuScale reported more than 60 specialized supply-chain partners and over 30 executed agreements.
NuScale and MillenniTEK successfully fabricated first-of-a-kind boron-oxide pellets for the passive ECCS.
The companies characterized the work as advancing specialized component manufacturing toward commercialization readiness.
NuScale reported $1.9 billion in cash, cash equivalents and short- and long-term investments.
Management stated the design holds U.S. NRC certification and cited more than 60 specialized supply-chain partners with over 30 agreements executed.

sources.origin: NuScale Power / NPX and Nuclearn AI deployment announcement
facts: NuScale is deploying nuclear-specific AI tools for engineering and knowledge management.
NuScale said its initial proof of concept reduced time required to find relevant information by as much as 80% while surfacing relevant engineering methods and standards.
NuScale and MillenniTEK successfully fabricated first-of-a-kind boron-oxide pellets for NuScale's passive emergency core cooling system.
NuScale characterized the milestone as progress in specialized component and manufacturing-process readiness for deployment.
